_note: Paths that sync_upstream.py must never overwrite or delete. Entries are matched by path prefix (relative to the fork root, '/' separated; a trailing '/' means a directory). Everything under a protected path is copied by neither the upstream-overwrite step nor the upstream-removal step, and upstream changes to it are only reported so a human can merge them by hand. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
_usage: Add fork-owned development paths here (e.g. "apps/my_new_app/"). Keep generated files out: mgu-repo.json is regenerated by fork-tools/gen_mgu_repo.py and must stay unprotected. kit/runtime/fonts/cjk.json IS listed: this fork bakes it itself (fork-tools/bake_cjk_fork.py), because upstream's baker only knows the characters of kit/runtime/locales/zh-CN.json and this fork's supplement would otherwise draw as '?'. kit/runtime/locales/zh-CN.json IS listed too: it is the catalog the build reads, and this fork's own file is upstream's entries merged with fork-tools/zh-CN-supplement.json (fork-tools/merge_supplement.py). A fork-only file elsewhere in the repo is not enough - on 2026-11-19 an app built on the unit came out with upstream's catalog only, so its tabs stayed English.
